correctness.rationale: For arbitrary deterministic initial state in the Schur stable range, epoch and iid recurrences are explicit 2-by-2 linear systems driven by independent signs. The unique Lyapunov covariance solutions give exact phase variances for all admissible real parameters. Symbolic algebra checks full matrix equations, phase indexing and rational witness; strict sign factorization classifies every boundary, with independent mathematical reasoning for positivity of denominators and location of thresholds. A finite experiment is not being passed off as a proof.

originality.rationale: The inspected closest heavy-ball epoch-noise article establishes all-step averaged stationary variances, not the distinct fixed-epoch-phase stationary covariance pair and its three exact crossings; its Appendix A explicitly distinguishes the two averages. Related works with RR momentum convergence bounds, periodic no-momentum RR, and independent matrix-product reversals do not imply the joint phase threshold statement. residual_risks: Kühn–Rosenow Appendix B already contains a covariance technique from which the phase formulas might be derived, and an earlier specialized derivation could exist; this claim of originality is about the not-previously-stated sharp phase-classification, not inventing the covariance method or the average.
Semantic result retrieval and examined articles do not constitute exhaustive worldwide priority proof; independent expert and bibliographic verification are not performed.

value.rationale: Within-epoch evaluation and epoch-end evaluation can give opposite strict rankings of the same stable, constant-step momentum optimizer; the sharp crossing values identify when. Strict positive momentum produces two extra interior crossings invisible from the all-step time-averaged noise floor. The phenomenon is natural to optimization checkpointing and sampling diagnostics and has a concrete rational example, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
